summary: Spark I Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K reporting redemptions tied to its September 25, 2026 EGM, where shareholders approved extending the business-combination deadline from September 29, 2026 to March 29, 2027. Holders of 609,668 Class A ordinary shares redeemed at roughly $11.68 per share, draining about $7.1 million from the trust, leaving approximately $19.0 million. Post-redemption, 6,445,104 Class A shares are outstanding: 1,627,045 public and 4,000,000 sponsor-held shares. No advisor, premium or combination target was disclosed. Watch further redemptions and search progress before the March 2027 deadline.
